added_claim_errors: 「社会保険料控除：約20〜40万円」 invents an amount and insurance circumstances absent from the request.
「所得税は0円」「効果があるのは住民税だけ」 are unjustifiably definite; insurance deductions and withholding must first be checked.
「過去の分も領収書があれば還付申告できます」 overstates eligibility: receipts alone do not establish a refund, and already-filed returns may require a different correction procedure.
「合わせて2,500円程度」 assumes income-tax savings without checking liability or withholding; the income-tax refund may be zero.
「給与が1か所で年末調整が済んでいるなら…申告の義務はありません」 omits the necessary qualification concerning other income.
「受けるには確定申告が必要」 overlooks claiming the deduction through a municipal resident-tax return.
「健康診断は対象外」 is too categorical: examinations leading to treatment of a discovered serious illness can qualify.
「年内に追加の治療があれば、その分だけ控除額も増えます」 omits that eligible expenses must actually be paid within the year and reduced by reimbursements.

reasons: Both immediately correct the threshold misconception, and their deduction calculations are correct; B's approximately ¥2,500 is reasonable rounding of ¥2,550, but its assumed income-tax benefit is unsupported. A narrowly wins because it identifies resident tax as the likely principal benefit and supplies the municipal filing option, although its invented insurance amount and categorical zero-tax conclusion substantially weaken its honesty. B gives clearer preparation instructions, while neither provides the complete refund-filing window or asks the reader to check withholding. The health-examination exception and distinction between refund filings and corrections to existing returns are assessed from general tax knowledge; no external sources were opened.
